annotations.title: Record how a shoe actually fits

description: Records what the person says about wearing a shoe they own: whether it is the right length and width. This is the most valuable thing they can tell us, because it is the difference between what the chart says and what happened. Use the shoe id from list_shoes.

dimension.description: Which way it fits or does not.

sessionId.description: The session id returned by start_session. Everything the person tells you is stored against it, and it is the only thing linking one call to the next.

verdict.description: What they said. PERFECT means they would buy it again.

name: rate_fit
